reviews.text: 小而美的塔防游戏，与传统塔防的区别在于资源是虽时间增加的且每一阶段的数量有限，部分怪物还会拆塔，合理规划固然重要，但如果卡关了可以试试先解锁其它升级项后再做挑战。前期的难度较为简单，堡垒开始难度有所上升，需要合理应用可以拉住敌人仇恨的防御塔，另外游戏中的升级项不是直接提升属性而是在建造防御塔后可以给予对应升级，不同防御塔的同一升级项目花费也有所不同。

I've only played the first two levels, and I can already see the potential here. I recently finished Thronefall and was craving something similar and I can tell this game is going to deliver a great or even better experience. Huge props to the dev team for the amazing audio design and the pixel art style it really adds a lot of charm to the game. Fantastic work overall! Also, shutout to Olexa! I found this game through him ❤️

Just a puzzle game, not a Tower Defense game, at least on most levels. Many levels require you to play with the exact towers and exact set up the developer designed them for to survive. Could be good, but is so constrained by the rails it is placed on that I cannot recommend it. 1/5 - Go play a real TD game.
Do you like Tower Defence? Do you like fantastic artwork and music? Then this is a game for you!

I do enjoy Tower Defense games and this game has some charm to it. I've only played a little over an hour but I had to come here to talk about one flaw with it that I really hope gets addressed. I play on Steam Deck and my biggest pet peeve is that the loading time takes FOREVER between levels. I have no problems loading with other games but for some reason this one chugs and takes about a minute to load each map. Its very frustrating and nearly a deal breaker because I can only tolerate so much waiting while I want to play more.

♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. I just came from a rabbit hole about fake game ads and was lamenting about how Kingshot's ad looks SO GOOD but I could tell it was pre-rendered and fake. Someone in the comment section said it's a re-skin of Thronefall and of COURSE I had to check it out. I saw this bundle, bought it on the into trailer alone, and I haven't even PLAYED Thronefall yet but this one is SO GOOD. I love tower defense games to the point that I buy some very..... interesting.. ones, but this. This hits the spot. This satisfies the craving. It's challenging with just enough puzzle to give it replay-ability. The graphics are so nice, the music and sound effects are very charming, and I can't wait to see what else this game brings. I hate that I just learned about this game! It's awakened my soul and it yearns for more... but my body said lights out and I can't read anymore. it's almost 12am and I have work tomorrow. Oops.

[h1] Monument Valley with Guns and Explosions? [/h1] If someone had once told me I'd be given the chance to play a tower defense game with a Monument Valley visual style, I'd have been surprised and wouldn't have immediately realized what it would look like. If I were asked now, I'd immediately point to Rift Riff. Brisk gameplay that immediately immerses you in the world. No long introductions - amazing. Slowly increasing difficulty. An incredibly engaging learning experience. I won't argue that the idea of ​​this particular tower defense is hardly new. [b] But oh my god, how WELL it's executed. [/b] I'd also like to mention [b]the sound[/b]. Movement, enemies, and buildings all create a high-quality, seamless impression of the world. The character himself amusingly falls into rifts and sings when left alone - it's fantastic. Chef's kiss The game immediately stole my attention for several hours. Thank you [i] Adriaan de Jongh, Sim Kaart, Matthijs Koster, Franz LaZerte and Professional Panda [/i] for such a fantastic game. The world of Rift Riff is something I want to explore, watch, and, of course, protect!

Cute little game, worth every dollar. The kind of puzzle TD that respects your time since it allows you to redo each wave without having to start over from scratch. Also quite forgiving as you can sell each tower in between rounds with full refund (and you will need that in many of the end game challenges to adapt to different monsters). Highly recommend.

It is very forgiving in certain ways but overall it is pretty unforgiving. Each level requires certain combination of towers and companions but its hard to know what that specific combination is when you start a level. You can end up getting through like 5 out of 6 rounds only to realize on the last one that you don't have the right combination. Then have to restart and not only replay those first five rounds but since you changed the combination you also then have to figure out a new strategy for those levels with the different towers. Overall, it is very fun for a few hours but then nowhere near fun enough to justify the amount of time required for the learning curve later in the game.

Solid game overall. I'll start with the bad bc there aren't much of it. → The early levels are a bit boring because of the very limited selection of turrets and companions. → The balance could be improved : ricochet tower is op while the stinger and self-destruct towers are AWEFUL. The hook tower is also very situational (mendatory in like 2-3 missions or challenges, and uber useless the rest of the time). → No easy mode or hints for casual players. Now with the positive. → OST is pretty good. → A pixel art that doesn't look bad. → Later levels require you to rethink your strategy instead of going for the most op towers all the time, thankfully we don't get the ricochet tower early on though :p Some maps are small, others are big, some have one path, others have multiple, some will throw rushing enemies while others will unleash enemies that go for your turrets, and so on. A couple of small ones even ask you to sell your turrets in order to match enemy waves, I love it! → The challenges unlocked near the end of the game are pretty cool, demanding specific strategies that you must find out by yourself. It's a smart way to recycle the entirety of the maps and extend the game's replayability. However, some challenges are ridiculously hard, bummer :/ I'm close to finishing the game, so I would say that it's about 15-20hours to get all levels and challenges, pretty much worth it. I wouldn't recommend it for casual players if you are also not patient enough to test different approaches. Solid game overall, well done Adriaan :) Personal note: 7/10
I don't even like tower defense and this slaps, so streamlined and fun to play. Challenging but never overwhelming.

I just finished the last challenge and I thought this was a very good game. Highly recommended. Just a few gripes - I wasn't a fan of having to restart the entire scenario just to change one tower late in the game. Perhaps you can allow people to choose towers as they go to a limit of 5 instead of having to choose all 5 towers at the beginning, this way I still retain the flexibilty of experimenting with differnent towers in the late waves. Also, maybe you can allow people to rewind to a particular wave instead of just restarting the previous one. But on the whole the game is very good.

The game is very similar to Thronefall but here you have a hub where you can buy new towers, companions and upgrade options for towers. On some levels the final wave can be challenging so thankfully you can restart a wave and rearrange your defenses. Visuals are nice and very colourful. But the best part is the sounds, all of the sounds. And these sounds combined with these visuals create an atmosphere so most of the times I don't want to leave. I hope we'll get a sequel
